# Skimmer test fixtures: SYNTHETIC

Every file in this folder was written by hand or by a script for testing.
None of it is real data from USGS, NOAA, GFZ, SIDC or Treasury. The layouts
follow what the parsers expect; they have NOT been checked against frozen real
files. Real fixtures go in ../real/ and come only from
tools/fetch-skimmer-fixtures.js, which has not been run yet.
